parsed.doc_summary: AAGLA article on the City of Los Angeles requirement that landlords of RSO-covered units pay interest on security deposits (LAMC 151.06.02), with a rate table through 2025.

rules.title: LA RSO security deposit interest requirement
rules.requirement: Landlords of rent-stabilized (RSO) units in the City of Los Angeles must pay tenants interest on security deposits, either monthly or yearly, as a direct payment or a rent credit. The landlord must tell the tenant in writing which method it chose.
rules.quoted_span: A tenant shall be given the unpaid accrued interest in the form of either a direct payment or a credit against the tenant’s rent.
rules.key_value: Annual City-set interest rate (4.320% for 2025); paid monthly or yearly
rules.effective_date_note: Interest began accruing November 1, 1990 per the quoted code text.
rules.penalty: Non-compliance can be used as a defense in eviction proceedings.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to properties subject to the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance.

unverifiable_exemptions: Other RSO exemptions (e.g., subsidized or government-owned units) cannot be checked from parcel data
